Triage: lands in `domain:ui` · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:ux · Feature · opening a record page full-page in a new tab shows 「正在打开你的控制台…」 until every boot read arrives, seconds on a hosted environment; draw the app shell once the session is confirmed and fill the page as reads arrive, keeping the guarantees the readiness gate exists for; split from #35416 → p2 as filed (UX rule) · size M (measure first).

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Scope addition · 2026-11-21T04:55Z · #35416 closes with its PR #35987, whose before/after numbers are local and throttled (the hosted environment is not reachable from the build container). The hosted before/after reading that #35416's acceptance names moves to this card, which re-measures the same boot path anyway. Acceptance, added: on the hosted environment, with JS cached, post the segment timings of the same full-page record open before #35987 and after this card, and show that `/api/v1/packages` no longer sits on the record page's boot path.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim: card thread · 2026-11-21T05:44Z · `Part of #35981` (the card closes when the hosted reading is posted; see Scope)
Area: b1-CX
Session: `session_01L6bhgWwKdjqiYQSujUXhn7` (the card thread, building itself under the dev-thread rule)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-myuwkz
Seat: `repo:objectstack#1`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: `ui/packages/app-shell` `console/AppContent.tsx`, `console/ConsoleShell.tsx`, `chrome/ConsoleBootShell.tsx` (new) and its `chrome/index` export; `ui/apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx`; the objectui#12809 splash test plus new pins; a changeset.
Container & model: `M/L`, `mode:thread`, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: no (provisional: `@object-ui/app-shell` is private; measured on the built declarations, and the claim is amended if it reads yes)
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise: re-read on main by the card thread: holds. A full-page `/apps/:app/*` open passes five splash gates today: the session read, the adapter, the organization list, `me/permissions`, then AppContent's app metadata, the admin verdict (objectui#5619) and the first-paint route reads (objectui#12809).
Basis: card #35981, split from #35416 under epic #34571, which the maintainer handed to this seat on 2026-11-21 03:24:57Z (「34571 专题你也接手」).
Scope: one PR, two parts. (1) After the session is confirmed, on `/apps/:app/*` only, the later gates draw a shell skeleton (top bar, sidebar frame, content skeleton, a phone variant) that names no app, shows no navigation item and decides nothing. (2) AppContent stops waiting for the first-paint route reads: the real chrome mounts once the app metadata, permissions and the admin verdict are in, with the existing `RouteMetadataSkeleton` in the route slot. The wrong-app, unauthorised-menu and redirect guarantees keep the same inputs as today; the layout jump, the `data-boot-splash` waiters and a session with no organization are pinned. Numbers in the PR are local and HTTP/2-throttled, labelled as such. The hosted before/after reading (seat note 7057574117) exists only after this PR deploys and cannot be taken from the build container, so the PR says `Part of` and the card stays open for that reading.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. #36000 (#35424 PR-a) touches `app-shell/src/index.ts` and `ConsoleLayout.tsx`; this PR stays out of `ConsoleLayout.tsx` and runs `overlap-check.mjs` before each push. The branch is the card thread's harness push branch, a measured platform exception to `claude/issue-<n>-<slug>`.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Progress · 2026-11-22T00:48Z · in progress (answers triage 7071767440 on #35349).

PR #36014 has carried L1-b delta ACCEPT 7059872679 on `759b08f6` since 2026-11-21T08:23Z; the seat missed its landing. Main is now 97 first-parent commits ahead, and #36187 removed the desktop top bar, so the boot frame must match the new chrome rather than only merge. Next step: the card thread merges main, makes the boot frame draw what the layout draws now, and reports a green head; L1-b reads the delta and the seat lands it. The hosted after-deploy reading still keeps the card open after merge.

repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5krBqrrgxCYgjXmfbv

**On hold · 2026-11-22T03:12Z** · the remaining item (the hosted after-deploy reading) came to seat 4 when seat 1 released it (mailbox #36124, 7073376074). Seat 4's area a4-H read what it needs and found that it cannot be taken yet.

- **What to measure** (seat note 7057574117 and the acceptance of #35416): on a hosted environment with JS cached, open the same record full page. Post the segment timings and show that `/api/v1/packages` is off the record page's boot path. The "before" reading is in #35416's body: os-4e4qa4.objectos.app, 2026-11-19, 16.3 s.
- **Missing:**
  1. A release that carries #35987 (changeset `35416-record-open-boot-waves.md`, still pending) and #36014, deployed to that environment. Releases are the maintainer's action.
  2. Network reach from a seat container to `*.objectos.app`. It is refused today.
  3. A sign-in to that environment that can open a `crm_opportunity` record.

Restart-when: the release carrying #35987 and #36014 is deployed to os-4e4qa4 (or another named hosted environment), and a seat can reach it and sign in. Area a4-H then takes the reading read-only.
